mapper.select: select rule_id, rule_type, rule_value, valid_from, valid_to from tax_rule
mapper.insert: insert into tax_calculation (account_id, calculated_at, basis_type, weighted_sell, original_gain_amount, weighted_gain, weighted_external_amount, adjust_ratio, final_deduction, final_tax) values (#{accountId}, #{calculatedAt}, #{basisType}, #{weightedSell}, #{originalGainAmount}, #{weightedGain}, #{weightedExternalAmount}, #{adjustRatio}, #{finalDeduction}, #{finalTax})
mapper.select: select calc_id, account_id, calculated_at, basis_type, weighted_sell, original_gain_amount, weighted_gain, weighted_external_amount, adjust_ratio, final_deduction, final_tax from tax_calculation where account_id = #{accountId} order by calculated_at desc, calc_id desc limit 1

select calc_id, account_id, calculated_at, basis_type, weighted_sell, original_gain_amount, weighted_gain, weighted_external_amount, adjust_ratio, final_deduction, final_tax from tax_calculation where account_id = #{accountId} and basis_type = #{basisType}

select id.inbound_detail_id, id.foreign_product_id, fp.ticker, fp.name, fp.market, fp.currency, id.purchase_fx_rate, id.purchase_price, id.current_qty, id.purchase_date, concat(fp.ticker, ' ', fp.name) as product_label from inbound_detail id join inbound i on i.inbound_id = id.inbound_id join foreign_product fp on fp.foreign_product_id = id.foreign_product_id where i.account_id = #{accountId} and id.current_qty > 0 order by id.purchase_date asc, id.inbound_detail_id asc
select count(*) from tax_snapshot ts where ts.final_tax > 0 and not exists ( select 1 from tax_calculation tc where tc.account_id = ts.account_id and tc.basis_type = 'FINAL_REPORT' )

select count(*) from account a join tax_calculation tc on tc.account_id = a.account_id and tc.basis_type = 'FINAL_REPORT' where a.benefit = 'IMPOSSIBLE' and not exists ( select 1 from tax_calculation tc2 where tc2.account_id = a.account_id and tc2.basis_type = 'EARLY_WITHDRAWAL_CLAWBACK' )
